messages:
Alex Wu: Quick heads-up — I'm handing off tonight at 21:00 PT. Doing one last access smoke test. Anyone oncall to grab a quick confirmation? @Priya Nair @Samir Patel

Priya Nair: I can confirm my pager test succeeded earlier. Device is on 2FA hardware key. VPN access still works via corp-vpn. Quick checklist: runbooks updated, creds rotated last week.

Samir Patel: Couldn't reach staging via bastion earlier, fixed by restarting jump host. Note: runbook step 2 still references 'bastion-old' — I'll submit a tiny PR to fix.

Alex Wu: Thanks — please ping the PR when ready. Also verifying the oncall runbook has the escalation matrix and contact numbers. Is PagerDuty schedule for tonight correct? @OncallBot

OncallBot: PagerDuty schedule shows 'eng-oncall - primary: Priya Nair, secondary: Samir Patel' for 2026-03-15 21:00-09:00 PT. Next rotation in 7 days. Pager test endpoint: https://pager.test/trigger

Priya Nair: I did a pager test from my phone (sms + push). Both arrived. Confirmed aws-prod access is blocked for oncall — that's expected. Can someone confirm the runbook credential snippet for service account 'svc/oncall-run' is still valid?

Devex: Quick note — creds for svc/oncall-run live in Secrets Manager path `/redwood/oncall/svc-run`. Password rotates monthly; last rotated 2026-03-01. I can add an expiration alert if helpful.

Samir Patel: Validated the secrets path and tested `aws ssm start-session` to a box — success. Leaving a comment on the runbook about the bastion host rename and adding the little ssh example:

``
ssh -J ubuntu@bastion-new.ec2.internal ec2-user@staging-01
```

Alex Wu: Awesome. One more ask: VPN clients — please ensure latest cert pushed before 20:30 PT. If anyone can't connect after that, post here and I'll remote join. :thumbsup:

Priya Nair: Copy. I'll hand over full notes to the oncall board and mark 'ready' in the oncall doc.
